topic: The HR manager who finally stopped processing leave requests on WhatsApp — what changed in week one
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
47 WhatsApp messages. Every Monday. Just to manage leave at a 90-person company.

Leave requests, approvals, complaints about missing approvals, a screenshot of a request from three weeks ago that nobody had processed.

That was the HR manager's inbox at a trading company in Muscat. Every single Monday, without fail.

Week one on SmartPRO Hub looked different.

Employees submitted leave through the platform. The manager saw every request — balances auto-calculated — in one dashboard. Approvals took seconds. Nothing got buried in a chat thread.

By Friday: zero pending requests. First time in two years.

No training marathon. No spreadsheet imports or data migrations. The team was live the same day they signed up.

SmartPRO Hub handles leave management, WPS payroll compliance, Omanization tracking, and Ministry of Labour filings in one connected system. Built specifically for Oman businesses. Not five separate tools. Not a WhatsApp group.

Here's what people miss when they frame this as a convenience problem: running HR through a chat app isn't just slow, it's a liability. Compliance exposure when approvals aren't documented. Decisions made on balances nobody's actually verified. A paper trail that exists only until someone deletes a message thread.

The 47 messages weren't the real cost. The real cost was everything that could go wrong because of them.

What's one workflow your team is still managing on WhatsApp that should have moved off it a year ago?
